How can I create AI product photos from a reference image with tested prompts and visible inputs and outputs? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
To create professional AI product photos from a reference image, you need a source-guided (image-to-image) workflow. This method ensures that the AI doesn't invent a generic product, but instead places your real product into high-quality, generated environments. 
NovaBrand AI
 +1
By using a verified framework like the Tolstoy Product Generation Workflow or PrompTessor Framework, you can systematically control inputs, utilize tested prompts, and accurately verify outputs. 
www.gotolstoy.com
 +1
1. Step-by-Step Production Workflow
Creating studio-quality assets requires dividing your process into clear input preparation, prompting, and output quality assurance. 
nightjar.so
 +1
[ Clean Reference Image ] + [ Bounded Prompt ] ➔ [ AI Generator / Settings ] ➔ [ QA & Output Verification ]

Step 1: Prepare a Clean Input Image: Your output quality is capped by your source photo. Upload a high-resolution image (at least 2048×2048 pixels, PNG or JPEG format). The product should be captured on a clean white or neutral gray background, under even, neutral lighting, showing the entire silhouette without clipped edges or unrelated props. 
Nim · The ultimate app for AI video production
Step 2: Define Model and Constraints: Choose an image-to-image capable tool (such as LXT Studio, Canva's AI Product Photos App, or an advanced model like Nano Banana Pro via OpenArt AI). Set the "creativity" or "image weight" slider to lower settings. A lower creativity value forces the AI to stay strictly anchored to the product shape, labels, and textures of your reference photo. 
nanabananapro.com
 +3
Step 3: Apply a Tested Prompt Structure: Describe the final scene you want to build around the product, rather than instructions on how to edit the image. A structured product prompt must explicitly dictate composition, surface texturing, and lighting variables. 
PrompTessor
 +2
Step 4: Quality Assurance (QA) Output Check: Generate up to 4–8 variations. Place the generated image directly alongside your original reference photo to audit for brand accuracy. Ensure that texturing, brand logos, seams, and physical dimensions remain true to the original item without bleeding into synthetic artifacts. 
OpenArt
 +3
2. Tested Prompt Templates
The following brand-neutral prompts from the Promer AI Template Library and PrompTessor Guide are built for commercial art direction: 
Promer AI
 +1
Template A: Clean Marketplace Listing (Studio Shot)
Prompt: A professional studio product photograph of [Your Product Name], positioned dead center on a smooth, matte light-gray platform. Clean minimalist setup, crisp focus. Soft white studio background. Illuminated by uniform, diffused overhead softbox lighting to eliminate harsh shadows. Photorealistic, 8k resolution, maintaining exact product texturing and dimensions from the reference image.
Template B: Premium Lifestyle Scene (Outdoor/Natural)
Prompt: A high-end commercial lifestyle image. The product from the reference image is resting on a pale, raw stone bench. The background features a softly blurred, warm Mediterranean courtyard in the morning sun. Bright, directional natural morning daylight casting gentle, soft-edged shadows. Elegant composition with empty space left in the upper third for text overlay. Photorealistic, depth of field effect.
3. Visible Inputs & Outputs (System Setup)
When executing this workflow, structure your digital workspace so every variable is logged. This enables you to reuse successful setups like a recipe. 
nightjar.so
 +1
Workflow Phase	Visible Element	Why It Matters / How to Monitor
Input Packet	Product Identity Reference	High-res PNG with isolated edges; gives the AI engine a readable boundary.
Input Packet	Product Facts Sheet	Dimensions, material notes, and color hex codes to prevent texturing errors.
Settings	Creativity Slider / Weight	Visible parameter value (e.g., 0.25 or Low); guarantees the AI preserves exact label text.
Generation	Bounded Prompt Text	Specifies what to generate around the item while forbidding alterations to the SKU.
Output Verification	Side-by-Side Variations Matrix	Displaying 4–8 options adjacent to the reference file to instantly flag warped logos or skewed geometry.
To help fine-tune a prompt for your workflow, could you tell me:
What type of product are you photographing (e.g., cosmetics, apparel, electronics)?
What is the desired background environment (e.g., a sleek bathroom counter, a rustic wooden table, an abstract pastel studio)?
